description.zh:
加速地域实例ID。

您可以通过调用[ListIpSets](~~2253273~~)查询指定全球加速实例下包含的加速地域实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the acceleration region.

You can call the [ListIpSets](~~2253273~~) operation to query the IDs of acceleration regions of a specific GA instance.

description.zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga describe-ip-set --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ip-set-id ips-bp11ilwqjdkjeg9r70000 --region cn-hangzhou
